# Results

Every measured nvsnap number, with its date, hardware, build and the record
it comes from. A number here is a record of that run, not a promise about the
current build. A number that turns out wrong is withdrawn here, in place, with
the reason; it is not silently replaced. "Not recorded" means the record does
not name it.

## CRIU with gpushare (multi-GPU)

Source: [design/GPUSHARE.md](design/GPUSHARE.md#validation). vLLM 0.20.0 at
default flags, 4x GB300, driver 610.57.04, unless the row says otherwise. nvsnap
build: not recorded. Output after restore matched the output before the
checkpoint byte for byte in every case.

| Workload | What was measured | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct, TP=4, checkpoint on one node, restore on another | New pod to first token | 87.8 s restoring from the store (network block PVC), 66.7 s from the node's copy (local NVMe) |
| same | Cold start to first token | 363 s with the 136 GB model download, 242 s without |
| same | Checkpoint size | 159 GiB written by the first checkpoint, 20 GiB by a second checkpoint of the same model |
| Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, TP=4, in place | Suspend / resume | about 6.5 s / 5.9 s; 3 of 3 cycles passed |
| Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, TP=8 across 2 nodes (4x GB300 each), in place | Suspend and resume with the fabric map | 5 of 6 cycles matched the baseline; the sixth merged a stale handle list (a test-driver error) |
| 1T-parameter MoE, TP=8 across 2 nodes, about 266 GB of GPU memory per rank, in place | Suspend and resume with the fabric map | 3 of 3 cycles matched the baseline |
| Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, TP=4, 4x H100, driver 580.126.16 | CRIU dump, restore into a new pod | Answered as before (with NVLS and symmetric-memory all-reduce off for driver 580) |

## CRIU, single GPU

Source: [results/BENCHMARK.md](results/BENCHMARK.md#faster-criu-v2-restore-levers-a--b-july-2026).
July 2026, H100 80GB, driver 580.126, an EKS cluster with NVMesh storage.
Agent restore time per build:

| Workload | Checkpoint | v0.2.20 | v0.2.21 | v0.2.22 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| vLLM, TinyLlama 1.1B | 3.2 GB | 44.3 s | 32.2 s | 25.8 s |
| vLLM, Llama-3.1-8B | 18 GB | 58.9 s | 38.5 s | 32.4 s |
| e5-mistral-7b | 15 GB | 84.0 s | 40.8 s | 36.6 s |
| vLLM, Qwen2.5-32B | 64 GB | 77.4 s | 48.5 s | 44.3 s |
